query.tier_b_rule: matched only 'linear probe' or 'superposition'; retained as a separate stratum, not scored

code_detection.method: arXiv HTML (v1/v2) full-text scan for repository URLs, then GitHub API existence/license/HEAD checks, then sentence-context classification of each link as an authored release or a cited dependency
code_detection.authored_release_rule: release language in the sentence around the link, or a recently-created low-star repo whose name matches the paper, with no dependency language
code_detection.known_limitation: papers with no arXiv HTML rendering, or code linked only from a PDF figure or an external project page, can be undercounted
